title: Test Fidelity Spectrum Across Engine Layers
description: Trace how each test tier trades execution latency for real browser and backend subsystems.

steps.label: 1. Unit Tier (V8 Isolate, ~1ms)
steps.description: Executes pure JS/TS functions and fake timers with zero DOM or browser process overhead.

steps.label: 2. Browser Component Tier (Blink Frame, ~60ms)
steps.description: Mounts isolated UI in a real browser frame with mocked network, verifying layout, focus, and ARIA.

steps.label: 3. E2E Tier (Full Stack, ~3500ms)
steps.description: Drives real browser navigation, cookies, and backend persistence end-to-end for critical paths.
